title: Problem with the x-brace detached upon arrival
text:
Problem with the x-brace detached upon arrival. The x-brace on the back of the ladder arrived with one strip detached. The brace should have been bolted onto the frame of the ladder. Instead, it was just a plug-in kind of fastener. I would have fastened it but could not do so because the hole in the frame of the ladder had not been drilled in the right spot, and so the plug could not be lined-up with the hole. That's why the X-frame had popped loose. It was not a matched fit.

It's too bad because I love the ladder's very thin width when it is in the folded position. It is lightweight and a nice ladder except that one can't help wondering if it is sturdy when one finds this kind of problem.
